argument: The letters must read as one oblique syntax field organized by an absence, not as twelve decorative initials. The diagonal slit, central void, unequal spacing, and produced marks must carry the composition before the UI does.

With readout, controls, note, hint, register, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v038's lexicon, v039's route sheet, and v040's pressure rack. It must read as a syntax made from omissions, not as a type specimen.
The viewer must attend to empty gaps, never select or press a glyph. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and the read control must make the same three-gap relation available without a hover-only requirement.
Pending gaps must be geometry-neutral. Completion must produce actual SVG text transforms and path marks in three untouched glyphs; status, colour, and prose cannot substitute for geometry.
The visited gaps and their neighbouring glyphs must stay exact. The consequence must arrive elsewhere, proving that an omission can be a writing event without becoming a local mark.
Order and distinctness must matter. An incomplete or repeated gap sequence must refuse commitment, while a completed sequence must recruit a deterministic remote trio.
Four readings must compound in one SVG field. Delete must reconstruct the exact previous geometry and release must restore the deterministic quiet constellation.
Generated SVG text, transforms, empty targets, and produced path marks are the medium. No screenshot, imported type specimen, CSS poster, or external font may carry the work.

little-critters is translated from situated proximity and reciprocal attention into attention to absences. Animals, eyes, characters, paper scene, source palette, source composition, source code, examples, and API surface are refused.

v041 changes medium, composition, viewer task, temporal threshold, and visible grammar: Canvas routes, DOM offers, and pressure chambers are replaced by a sparse SVG absence field whose only commitment is a completed reading of three empty gaps.

Delete v041 if the blind field is a generic type specimen, if touching a glyph is the easiest path, if gaps are decorative controls, if remote marks are cosmetic, if later readings reset, or if lifting is inexact.
